name: FX Labs · Fire Generator

title.zh: FX Labs · 比较烟雾火焰效果

description.zh: 看Fire实际火苗与参数；未操作导出或付款。 FX Labs 是在浏览器中调整烟雾、火焰等图像效果的工具，工作台提供参数控件、效果预览与 JPEG 导出入口。定价区分个人免费与付费 Pro 方案，免费商用条件与 Terms 表述有冲突，输出权限和平台程序源码须分开判断。
description.en: FX Labs provides browser-based editors for smoke, fire and other image effects, with parameter controls and JPEG export. Free personal and paid Pro plans differ in export formats and permissions; broader terms conflict with free-plan commercial restrictions, so those rights remain unresolved.

Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by FX Labs (https://fxlabs.app/).
